# Askurdoctor.net

> A nonprofit health initiative providing free medical consultations, educational resources, and news focused on urology and general health conditions.

Askurdoctor.net serves as a comprehensive health information platform offering evidence-based medical education, clinical research updates, and patient guides. The site emphasizes urology specialization while covering broader health topics including pandemic news, chronic conditions, and preventive care.

## Key Topics

- Urology
- Prostate Cancer
- Kidney Stones
- Bladder Cancer
- Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia (BPH)
- Prostatitis
- Urinary Incontinence
- COVID-19 Pandemic
- Medical Education
- Minimally Invasive Surgery
- Robotic Surgery
- Patient Guides
- Kidney Health
- Health Conditions
- Dr. Sagar Joshi

## Core Platform

- [Askurdoctor.net Home](https://www.askurdoctor.net): Nonprofit health initiative offering free consultations, news, and urology resources
- [Download Android App](https://www.askurdoctor.net/p/askurdoctornetdownload-android-app.html): Mobile app download page for Android health consultation platform
- [Join Us](https://www.askurdoctor.net/p/contribute.html): Volunteer recruitment page for submitting health articles and content

## Medical Education & Guides

- [Achalasia; Everything you need to know](https://www.askurdoctor.net/2022/01/achalasia-everything-you-need-to-know.html): Comprehensive medical guide on achalasia symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment
- [Migraine; Everything you need to know](https://www.askurdoctor.net/2022/01/migraine-everything-you-need-to-know.html): Medical education guide on migraine types, triggers, and symptoms
- [Home remedies for knee joint pain (Arthritis)](https://www.askurdoctor.net/2022/01/home-remedies-for-knee-joint-pain.html): Guide on natural and herbal remedies for arthritis and joint pain relief

## Health News & Research

- [94% of patients with cancer respond well to COVID-19 vaccines: Study](https://www.askurdoctor.net/2021/07/94-of-patients-with-cancer-respond-well.html): Clinical research article on COVID-19 vaccine efficacy in cancer patients
- [Coronavirus Pandemic: China reopens as rest of the world locks down](https://www.askurdoctor.net/2020/03/coronavirus-pandemic-china-reopens-as.html): News article on COVID-19 pandemic response and global lockdown impacts
- [Our Bodies Age in Three Distinct Shifts, According to More Than 4,000 Blood Tests](https://www.askurdoctor.net/2019/12/our-bodies-age-in-three-distinct-shifts.html): Research article on biological aging patterns from blood protein analysis
- [Cooperative efforts can end the corona pandemic in this year, says WHO chief](https://www.askurdoctor.net/2022/01/cooperative-efforts-can-end-corona.html): News article on WHO pandemic response and global vaccination goals
- [Coronavirus cases on rise in India; 703 deaths, 3.47 lakh new cases in 24 hours](https://www.askurdoctor.net/2022/01/coronavirus-cases-on-rise-in-india-703.html): COVID-19 pandemic update with India health statistics and case data
- [Doctor's Day 2023: Honoring the Heroes of Healthcare](https://www.askurdoctor.net/2023/07/doctors-day-2023-honoring-heroes-of.html): Commemorative article celebrating healthcare professionals and medical heroes
